APP_TITLE: Setsi sa Thuto sa Bopulamadibogo ba Aforika - Kwa Ntle
WELCOME_SUB: Kgoro ya go Nonotsha Aforika ka Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Go keteka Letsatsi la bo 25 la Aforika, App eno ya Katiso ya Bopulamadibogo ba Pi e simolotse)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network ke projeke ya madi a dijithale le ecosystem ya lefatshe lotlhe e e diretsweng go dira gore cryptocurrency e fitlhelelwe le go nna mosola mo mongwe le mongwe.
INTRO_P2: Go farologana le di-cryptocurrency tsa setso tse di tlhokang metšhini e turu ya go epa le motlakase o montsi, Pi Network e letla batho ba tlwaelegileng go tsaya karolo ka tlhamalalo mo megaleng ya bone.
INTRO_P3: Ponelopele ya Pi Network ke go aga ecosystem e e gogiwa ke batho kwa madi a dijithale a ka dirisiwang go dirisiwa ga nnete, ditirelo tsa nnete, ditšhaba tsa nnete le go tsaya karolo ga ikonomi ya nnete.
GLOBAL_MISSION: Maikaelelo a Lefatshe Lotlhe a Pi Network
M1: Go aga ikonomi ya dijithale e e akaretsang mongwe le mongwe
M2: Go nonotsha batho ba tlwaelegileng mo lefatsheng lotlhe
M3: Go oketsa tiriso ya botshelo jwa nnete
M4: Go tshegetsa kgwebo ya motho le motho
M5: Go aga ecosystem e e phatlaladitsweng
M6: Go rotloetsa go tsaya karolo ga baagi
CH1_SUB: Amogelesega mo Setsing sa Thuto sa Bopulamadibogo ba Aforika - Kwa Ntle. Sefalana se se diretswe go ruta, go nonotsha le go baakanyetsa bopulamadibogo ba Aforika le dikgwebo go tsaya karolo ka tshwanelo mo Pi Ecosystem.
INVITE_LINK: Dirisa kgokagano ya taletso ya semmuso: https://minepi.com/chigalex1
REG2: Ikwadise ka Facebook kgotsa Nomoro ya Mogala
REG4: Amogela tuelo ya gago ya 1 Pi
DAILY_MINING: Go Epa ga Malatsi Otle: Boa morago morago ga diura di le 24 gore o tswelele go epa.
MAINNET_TITLE: Lenaane la go Tlhatlhoba la Mainnet
WALLET_SEC: Tshireletsego ya Wallet: O se ka wa abelana mafoko a gago a le 24 a Passphrase. Mongwe le mongwe yo o nang le mafoko ao ke mong wa wallet.
CH2_DESC: Ithute ka fa o ka amogelang le go romela Pi ka tshireletsego ka go dirisa Pi Wallet mo Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: KGAOLO 2A — KATISO E E MOSOLA YA PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Simolola ka madi a mannye a teko, netefatsa aterese, o se ka wa abelana passphrase ya gago.
CH3_DESC: Pi Browser DApps ke ditiriso tse di phatlaladitsweng tsa tiriso ya nnete.
CH4_DESC: Lekola dikgwebo tse di amogelang Pi mo lefatsheng lotlhe.
CH5_DESC: Boleng jwa Tumalano ya Lefatshe (GCV) bo rotloetsa tiriso ya nnete mo ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Ithute buka ya Doris Yin ya go tlhama tiriso le go gola ga ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Ka fa o ka tsenang mo ecosystem, go kwadisa kgwebo ya gago mo MapOfPi, go amogela tuelo ya Pi.
FINAL_P: Aforika e na le tshono ya go nna nngwe ya dikgaolo tse di nonofileng thata mo tirisong e e mosola mo Pi Ecosystem. Re aga mmogo. Re ruta mmogo. Re nonotsha Aforika mmogo ka Pi.
